sma9.name: SMA 9
sma9.description: Simple average of the last 9 closes — very short-term trend.

sma100.name: SMA 100
sma100.description: Simple average of the last 100 closes — long-term trend.

ema9.name: EMA 9
ema9.description: Exponential average weighting recent closes — fast trend line.

ema100.name: EMA 100
ema100.description: Exponential 100 — a common long-term dynamic support/resistance.

dema20.name: DEMA 20
dema20.description: Double EMA — less lag than a plain EMA.

tema20.name: TEMA 20
tema20.description: Triple EMA — even less lag, reacts quickly to turns.

trima20.name: TRIMA 20
trima20.description: Triangular average — extra-smooth, weights the middle of the window.

rma14.name: RMA 14 (Wilder)
rma14.description: Wilder's smoothing — the average RSI and ATR are built on.

vwma20.name: VWMA 20
vwma20.description: Volume-weighted average — heavier-volume candles count more.

ichimoku.name: Ichimoku Cloud
ichimoku.description: Conversion, base and the leading cloud — trend, momentum and support in one view.

psar.name: Parabolic SAR
psar.description: Dots under price in uptrends, above in downtrends — a trailing stop guide.

aroon.name: Aroon
aroon.description: How recently price made a 25-bar high vs low — trend strength and changes.

vortex.name: Vortex
vortex.description: +VI above −VI = uptrend; crossovers flag trend changes.

massindex.name: Mass Index
massindex.description: Range expansion — a bulge above 27 then back under 26.5 warns of a reversal.

bop.name: Balance of Power
bop.description: Buyers vs sellers inside each candle (close vs open over the range).

qstick.name: Qstick
qstick.description: Average candle body — positive means mostly green candles.

cfo.name: Chande Forecast
cfo.description: Percent gap between price and its linear-regression forecast.

apo.name: Absolute Price Osc
apo.description: Fast EMA minus slow EMA in price terms — trend direction and strength.

rsi.name: RSI (14)
rsi.description: Relative Strength Index — over 70 overbought, under 30 oversold.

stochrsi.name: Stoch RSI
stochrsi.description: Stochastic of RSI (14,14,3,3) — fast overbought / oversold turns.

macd.name: MACD (12, 26, 9)
macd.description: Moving Average Convergence Divergence — line vs signal crossovers.

stoch.name: Stochastic
stoch.description: Close vs the 14-bar range (%K) and its average (%D).

kdj.name: KDJ
kdj.description: Stochastic with a J line that leads turns — popular in crypto.

roc.name: Rate of Change
roc.description: Percent change vs 12 candles ago — momentum speed.

trix.name: TRIX
trix.description: Rate of change of a triple-smoothed EMA — filters out noise.

cci.name: CCI (20)
cci.description: Commodity Channel Index — beyond ±100 is a strong move.

willr.name: Williams %R
willr.description: Close vs 14-bar high — above −20 overbought, below −80 oversold.

ppo.name: PPO
ppo.description: Percentage Price Oscillator — MACD in percent, comparable across coins.

po.name: Projection Oscillator
po.description: Where price sits inside its regression-projected band.

keltner.name: Keltner Channel
keltner.description: EMA with ATR-based bands — breakouts and trend-riding.

donchian.name: Donchian Channel
donchian.description: Highest and lowest close of 20 candles — classic breakout channel.

accbands.name: Acceleration Bands
accbands.description: Bands that widen with momentum — closes outside hint at acceleration.

chandelier.name: Chandelier Exit
chandelier.description: ATR trailing stops for longs and shorts.

atr.name: ATR (14)
atr.description: Average True Range — how much price typically moves per candle.

bbw.name: Bollinger Width
bbw.description: Band width — low readings mean a squeeze before a bigger move.

ulcer.name: Ulcer Index
ulcer.description: Downside volatility — depth and length of drawdowns.

stddev.name: Standard Deviation
stddev.description: 20-candle standard deviation of closes — raw volatility.

vwap.name: VWAP
vwap.description: Volume-weighted average price — the fair-value line traders watch.

obv.name: On-Balance Volume
obv.description: Running volume total — rising OBV confirms buying pressure.

mfi.name: Money Flow Index
mfi.description: Volume-weighted RSI — over 80 overbought, under 20 oversold.

cmf.name: Chaikin Money Flow
cmf.description: Buying vs selling pressure over 20 candles.

adl.name: Accumulation / Distribution
adl.description: Volume flowing in (closes near highs) vs out (closes near lows).

force.name: Force Index
force.description: Price change × volume — strength behind moves.

emv.name: Ease of Movement
emv.description: How easily price moves for the volume traded.

vpt.name: Volume Price Trend
vpt.description: Cumulative volume scaled by percent price change.

nvi.name: Negative Volume Index
nvi.description: Tracks price on quieter days — where 'smart money' tends to act.

pvo.name: Percentage Volume Osc
pvo.description: Volume momentum — fast vs slow volume EMA in percent.
